[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 11 - 16]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a five (5)-year Contract to ServiceTec International Inc. dba Delaware ServiceTec International Inc.: Covering comprehensive technical operations and maintenance support for the automated biometric boarding gates and associated systems installed at Los Angeles International Airport, for cost not to exceed $6,642,979 (Aura Moore)
summary: Awards a five-year contract to ServiceTec to maintain the automated biometric boarding gates and related systems at LAX, capped at $6,642,979.

locations.text: Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA
